rows.question: Which scholarly works have emerged from the collaborative efforts involving Peter Mertens, are interlinked through other contributors, and are expressly associated with Dina Barbian?

WITH
-- all papers authored by Peter Mertens
peter AS (
  SELECT w.paperId
  FROM author a
  JOIN writes w ON w.authorId = a.authorId
  WHERE a.authorName = 'Peter Mertens'
),
-- all authors who have coauthored some paper with Peter Mertens (excluding Peter)
coauthors_of_peter AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w2.authorId
  FROM writes w2
  WHERE w2.paperId IN (SELECT paperId FROM peter)
    AND w2.authorId NOT IN (
      SELECT authorId FROM author WHERE authorName = 'Peter Mertens'
    )
),
-- all papers that list Dina Barbian as an author
dina_papers AS (
  SELECT w.paperId
  FROM author a
  JOIN writes w ON w.authorId = a.authorId
  WHERE a.authorName = 'Dina Barbian'
),
-- papers that have at least one author from coauthors_of_peter
papers_with_peters_coauthor AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.paperId
  FROM writes w
  WHERE w.authorId IN (SELECT authorId FROM coauthors_of_peter)
),
-- final set: papers that list Dina and are either directly coauthored by Peter or include one of Peter's coauthors
result_papers AS (
  SELECT p.paperId, p.title, p.year
  FROM paper p
  WHERE p.paperId IN (SELECT paperId FROM dina_papers)
    AND (
      p.paperId IN (SELECT paperId FROM peter) -- Peter is a direct coauthor on the same paper
      OR
      p.paperId IN (SELECT paperId FROM papers_with_peters_coauthor) -- linked via an intermediate coauthor
    )
)
SELECT paperId, title, year
FROM result_papers
ORDER BY year DESC, paperId ASC
